originalTitle: What Has Home Depot Stopped Telling You About Where Its Goods Come From?
summary: Home Depot (HD) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained close to 17%. Where the goods on its shelves come from used to be something management explained at length. Now you mostly hear how fast they arrive.
content:
Home Depot (HD) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past year , while the S&P 500 gained close to 17%. Where the goods on its shelves come from used to be something management explained at length. Now you mostly hear how fast they arrive.

Image by Steve Buissinne from Pixabay

Home Depot Used To Make A Point Of Its Sourcing

In May 2025, management gave its global sourcing strategy a passage of its own. More than half of Home Depot’s purchases were sourced in the United States then, and vendors had spent years diversifying the retailer’s global supply chain.

That passage has no counterpart in the August 2026 call, and nothing as it has appeared on any call in between. Sourcing does not come up at all. The supply chain still does, mostly as a way to get product to customers faster.

Now Home Depot Would Rather Talk About Speed

Home Depot launched Express Delivery nationwide in August 2026, promising tens of thousands of products in three hours or less. The company has cut delivery lead times in the United States by about 45% over the past 18 months. Fulfillment is the story management wants now.

Sales on its digital platforms rose 11% in fiscal Q2 2026, a fifth straight quarter of double-digit growth. Magic Apron, its AI assistant, now answers questions in the aisles of every U.S. store. All of it is about the last few miles to the customer, and none of it about where the product was bought.

Does Home Depot’s Quiet On Sourcing Change What You Own?

The sourcing question did not disappear. It moved to the cost line. IEEPA tariff refunds cut Home Depot’s cost of goods sold by $685 million in fiscal Q2 2026.

Management says that money is already committed, offsetting unplanned and rising cost pressures from fuel, energy and other product inputs across fiscal 2026. The company puts the net benefit of those refunds at about 85 basis points of gross margin in the quarter, so the refund flatters a quarter rather than deciding the year. It is what the sourcing story has been reduced to: an accounting answer where there used to be a strategic one.

The operating margin over the past twelve months is 12.4% , against a three-year average of 13.4%. That is a full point below its own three-year average. The one thing that helped was not of the company’s own making. Management calls the tariff refund a market-borne benefit, not unique to Home Depot.

Does the silence change what you own? On its own, no – nothing in the August 2026 call says the supply chain got worse. The timing is what makes this worth noticing.

Management says the refunds were all booked when the cash arrived in the second quarter, and expects that timing benefit to be offset to a degree in fiscal Q3 2026, which Home Depot reports in November. That is the first quarter without the bulk of that benefit. Of the $730 million Home Depot received, $685 million landed in the second quarter and $45 million is still in inventory, reaching the cost line over the rest of the year. Whether a fall like this one is an entry is a separate question, and our dip-buying playbook ranks the stocks that have dropped this far.

Unanswered Questions Cost The Biggest Holders The Most

When management leaves questions open, the uncertainty weighs heaviest on whoever owns the most of the stock. Concentration tends to arrive by accident rather than by decision. chineseTitle: 家得宝 (Home Depot) 为何不再告诉您其商品的来源？
chineseSummary: 家得宝 (HD) 股票在过去一年中下跌了约四分之一，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了近 17%。货架上的货物来自哪里，管理层曾经详细解释过。现在你主要听到他们到达的速度有多快。
chineseContent:
家得宝 (HD) 股票在过去一年中下跌了约四分之一，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了近 17%。货架上的货物来自哪里，管理层曾经详细解释过。现在你主要听到他们到达的速度有多快。

该图片由Steve Buissinne在Pixabay上发布

家得宝 (Home Depot) 曾注重采购

2025 年 5 月，管理层为其全球采购战略开辟了一条自己的道路。当时家得宝一半以上的采购来自美国，供应商花了数年时间使零售商的全球供应链多元化。

该段落在 2026 年 8 月的电话会议中没有对应内容，并且在其间的任何电话会议中也没有出现过。采购根本就没有出现。供应链仍然如此，主要是为了更快地将产品交付给客户。

现在家得宝宁愿谈论速度

家得宝于 2026 年 8 月在全国范围内推出快递服务，承诺在三小时或更短的时间内送达数万件商品。过去 18 个月，该公司已将美国的交货周期缩短了约 45%。成就感是管理层现在想要的。

2026 财年第二季度，其数字平台销售额增长 11%，连续第五个季度实现两位数增长。它的人工智能助手 Magic Apron 现在在美国每家商店的过道里回答问题。所有这些都与客户的最后几英里有关，与产品的购买地点无关。

家得宝对采购的沉默会改变你所拥有的东西吗？

采购问题并没有消失。它移动到成本线。 IEEPA 关税退款使家得宝 2026 财年第二季度的销售成本减少了 6.85 亿美元。

管理层表示，资金已经到位，抵消了 2026 财年燃料、能源和其他产品投入带来的计划外和不断上升的成本压力。该公司将这些退款的净收益估计为该季度毛利率的 85 个基点左右，因此退款是按季度进行的，而不是决定年份。这就是采购故事已被简化为：一种会计答案，而以前是一个战略答案。

过去 12 个月的营业利润率为 12.4%，而三年平均值为 13.4%。这比三年平均水平低了整整一个百分点。唯一有帮助的事情并不是公司自己做的。管理层称关税退款是市场带来的好处，并非家得宝独有。

沉默会改变你所拥有的吗？就其本身而言，不——2026 年 8 月的电话会议中没有任何内容表明供应链变得更糟。时机使得这一​​点值得注意。

管理层表示，退款已在第二季度现金到达时全部记入，并预计时间优势将在 2026 财年第三季度得到一定程度的抵消（家得宝在 11 月报告称）。这是没有大量收益的第一季度。家得宝收到的 7.3 亿美元中，有 6.85 亿美元在第二季度到位，4500 万美元仍在库存中，在今年剩余时间里达到了成本线。像这样的下跌是否值得入市是一个单独的问题，我们的逢低买入策略对跌幅如此之大的股票进行了排名。

悬而未决的问题让最大的持有者付出了最大的代价
